residual_risk: Privileged live compromise can read keys or plaintext from an authorized process or kernel.
control_or_treatment: Host isolation, least privilege, MAC, separate broker, rapid drain, incident response.
owner_decision: Accept host trust boundary or require stronger execution isolation.

residual_risk: Principal authority may map a user, service, tenant, or project incorrectly.
control_or_treatment: Immutable authority IDs, signed authorization assertions, audit trail, separation of duties.
owner_decision: Select principal authority and lifecycle.

residual_risk: Sharing policy may authorize a dedup scope broader than users expect.
control_or_treatment: Explicit sharing class in AAD/manifests; default private; review public promotion.
owner_decision: Approve tenant/project/public sharing policy.

residual_risk: Parent key ownership, escrow, or recovery authority can expand access and defeat erasure.
control_or_treatment: Document owner/custodian, quorum, escrow, backup KEK, destroy authority, audit.
owner_decision: Assign key ownership and escrow policy.

residual_risk: Restored or rolled-back nonce allocator state can cause nonce reuse.
control_or_treatment: Per-rank epoch; crash-safe reservation; restored state always receives new epoch/key.
owner_decision: Approve allocator and persistence implementation.

residual_risk: Randomly generated nonces retain a non-zero collision probability and invocation bound.
control_or_treatment: 96-bit nonces from approved RNG, per-key invocation cap well below source limit, rotate early.
owner_decision: Select deterministic reservation or bounded random strategy.

residual_risk: AEAD accepts an old valid object unless trusted freshness is checked.
control_or_treatment: Epoch floor, manifest generation, expiration, source revision, monotonic publish record.
owner_decision: Define freshness and rollback tolerance.

residual_risk: Keyed identifiers reveal equality within their authorized dedup scope.
control_or_treatment: Minimize scope; rotate identifier epochs only with migration plan; avoid exposing index.
owner_decision: Accept within-scope equality leakage.

residual_risk: Ciphertext length, object count, access pattern, allocation, and timing remain observable.
control_or_treatment: Length buckets/padding where justified, scheduler isolation, per-tenant indexes, batching, rate limits.
owner_decision: Choose performance/privacy trade-off.

residual_risk: Shared cache timing can reveal a hit/miss or cross-tenant activity even when errors are normalized.
control_or_treatment: Tenant-local lookup path, equalized error classes, jitter/batching only if measured, quota isolation.
owner_decision: Set side-channel objective and performance budget.

residual_risk: fscrypt master-key removal leaves keys for open/in-use files.
control_or_treatment: Drain processes, close files, change cwd/root references, verify removal status, restart if necessary.
owner_decision: Set revocation SLA that accounts for drain.

residual_risk: An active dm-crypt mapping retains the volume key while busy or deferred.
control_or_treatment: Stop I/O, unmount, close mapping, verify device-mapper state, avoid treating deferred close as completion.
owner_decision: Set maintenance and emergency availability policy.

residual_risk: Keys/plaintext can remain in process memory, VFS caches, swap, crash dumps, registers, or hardware buffers.
control_or_treatment: mlock where appropriate, no core dumps, encrypted swap, short-lived workers, explicit zeroization, process exit, dump controls.
owner_decision: Accept limits of software memory erasure.

residual_risk: LUKS header backups or detached headers provide alternate unlock paths.
control_or_treatment: Inventory, encrypt separately, access-control, rotate/destroy coherently, test restoration under change control.
owner_decision: Retain or prohibit header backups.

residual_risk: Backup KMS replicas, escrow, snapshots, and offline copies can outlive logical deletion.
control_or_treatment: Retention ledger, deletion propagation, legal holds, backup expiry, key-copy inventory.
owner_decision: Define retention and legal-hold policy.

residual_risk: Restoring old ciphertext plus still-valid old keys can resurrect deleted or revoked content.
control_or_treatment: Quarantine restore, trusted epoch floor, tombstone ledger, rewrap/re-encrypt into current context.
owner_decision: Define restore authorization and rollback window.

residual_risk: dm-integrity authenticated modes add performance, recovery, and maturity complexity.
control_or_treatment: Prototype, benchmark, fault-inject, pin versions/configuration, keep object AEAD regardless.
owner_decision: Decide whether block integrity is worth operational cost.

residual_risk: Discard pass-through leaks allocation and does not prove sanitization.
control_or_treatment: Default off; document exception; do not use as erasure evidence.
owner_decision: Approve performance exception.

residual_risk: Sanitize commands may not reach remapped, failed, over-provisioned, or provider-controlled media.
control_or_treatment: Use media-specific procedure and authoritative vendor/provider capability; verify/validate; destroy where required.
owner_decision: Select purge/destroy method and acceptance evidence.

residual_risk: A cloud or storage provider may not expose evidence sufficient to validate media sanitization.
control_or_treatment: Contractual controls, provider attestations/evidence, encryption key control, data-lifecycle audit.
owner_decision: Accept provider assurance model or avoid persistent cache there.

residual_risk: Different implementations may canonicalize AAD, identifiers, or manifests differently.
control_or_treatment: Versioned deterministic encoding, test vectors, reject duplicate/unknown critical fields, cross-language conformance.
owner_decision: Approve canonical format and compatibility policy.

residual_risk: Quarantine storage can become an alternate serving path or retain sensitive evidence indefinitely.
control_or_treatment: Separate credentials/path, no cache lookup integration, retention cap, access logging, incident hold workflow.
owner_decision: Set evidence retention and access authority.

residual_risk: Detailed cryptographic error logs can become a tenant oracle or leak key/identifier material.
control_or_treatment: Opaque external miss; access-controlled internal reason code; redact secrets; aggregate metrics; rate limit.
owner_decision: Set logging retention and analyst access.

residual_risk: A compromised public/system publisher can distribute semantically malicious but cryptographically valid content.
control_or_treatment: Two-person publication, reproducible generation, signed immutable manifests, rollback and emergency revoke.
owner_decision: Select publisher authority and review process.

residual_risk: Strict fail-closed behavior can amplify denial-of-service through repeated misses and recomputation.
control_or_treatment: Per-principal quotas, backoff, duplicate recompute suppression, circuit breakers, protected authoritative source.
owner_decision: Set availability and abuse-control budget.
